---
title: Sweet Paprika Cream Cheese
id: MAR-0026
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 45
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 300 g cream cheese
- 2 fresh spring onion
- 3 bell pepper
- 2 tablespoons lemon juice
- 1 tablespoon sweet paprika
- 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
- to taste black pepper
## Method
1. Peel, wash the fresh spring onions and cut them into small cubes.
2. Drain the bell peppers, dry them and cut them into small cubes.
3. Work the cream cheese with the extra virgin olive oil, sweet paprika, black pepper and lemon juice.
4. Add the fresh spring onions and bell peppers and mix.
5. Serve this cream with toasted bread or homemade breadsticks.
